scope: Reporting conventions C1–C29 as registered. The supporting record of each convention is linked to the artifacts of THIS repository: 'run' lists files relative to a run directory (verified against the files the released runtime writes in the bundled example runs), 'records' names record sets of records/specs.json, 'module' names repository modules or tests, 'campaign' names campaign export modules 'absent' names a record the released code does not produce, and 'displays' the displays that record serves (used to link a declared record contract).

C1.convention: Two interval units accompany every paired effect: the test-stage interval of main Table 1 resamples optimization seeds and graphs; the admission moments of Table S13 condition on the fixed deployed ensemble (Note S24; Fig. S20c)

C2.convention: Confirmation, comparison and admission read disjoint data roles reserved at preparation (D_confirm, D_compare, D_admit; Table S39)

C3.convention: Support statistics are computed per (stratum, action) cell from one logged weight vector, so min_c ESS_c ≤ 1/(max_c,i v_ci)² holds on every cell (Table S7)

C4.convention: |Q_s| is the size of the eligible set under main Eq. (19); ogbn-products has |Q_s| = 0 and returns q_C

C5.convention: Outer-fold representatives and nested family comparisons are distinct estimators (Tables S12, S12b)

C6.convention: Improvement relative to zero, improvement beyond the practical margin and equivalence within the margin are three tests with three labels (Tables S11, S14)

C7.convention: Each factorial cell records its integration domain; a read-only observer on the nominal trajectory reproduces cell 000 (Table S16)

C8.convention: Internal recovery is part of C_S in main Eq. (32) (p_1 = 0 for the deployed rules); only q_B aborts to a restarted comparator (Algorithm S3; Table S34)

C9.convention: A resolvent step executes T sparse products and reaches T hops; the identity mass of the kernel and the identity coefficient of the executed operator are listed separately (Tables S6, S6b)

C10.convention: Each backbone's native call, controlled depth index and A0 identity are declared before instrumentation (Tables S5b, S5c)

C11.convention: Serial-cost ranges (Table S15) and per-rerun entries (Table S15b) carry their own units; Peptides SD is in AP percentage points

C12.convention: The admission-stage oracle is a diagnostic enumerated after every decision is fixed (Table S30); scaling curves are measured separately (Fig. S2)

C13.convention: Qualification GPU-hours are decomposed into exploration logging, model fitting, nested selection, confirmation, comparison and admission (Table S41)

C14.convention: The registered selector (ε_eq = {epsilon_eq} on U_s, least-complex near-best configuration) is replayed on the complete candidate ledger; the representative rows of Table S12 summarize that ledger (Table S12c)

C15.convention: Per-checkpoint training, ensemble composition and the {hpo_trials}-trial search are separate accounting units (Tables S5, S15b, S23)

C16.convention: One selected rule identifies every comparator q_C; its family and selection record are part of the results schema (Table S38)

C17.convention: Conditional state destruction replaces controller observations only; plant state and support are checked separately

C18.convention: Native AP and AP percentage points are labelled distinctly; paired effects are computed per graph before averaging (Table S26)

C19.convention: Extended-depth probes (Fig. S14) are reported separately from the controlled depth range

C20.convention: The confirmatory contrasts are the nine rows of Table S14; every other contrast of main Fig. 3 is exploratory

C21.convention: Latency entries share one execution object: the warm-up, synchronization, batching, placement and normalization of E17 (Tables S15b, S23)

C22.convention: The violation rate of Table S22 is the complement of mode-stable trajectory coverage

C23.convention: Retained-share crossovers are stated in one normalization: 1 against full feedback and r_B against selective sensing (main Proposition 10; Tables S46–S47)

C24.convention: Algorithm S3 holds the restart reserve until the final prediction; invariant w + W_C ≤ W (Lemma S1; Fig. S11)

C25.convention: False-safe and harm-miss rates are defined at sequence level and at action level (Table S37)

C26.convention: Full-state degree-8 sensing is priced at 8r/(1 + r) of a nominal step; proteins and PascalVOC-SP run the reduced sensors of Table S6c

C27.convention: Observer and consequence models are fitted on D_explore; D_fit trains the plant (Tables S2, S39)

C28.convention: A0 belongs to the supported set of every stratum, so both regret inequalities of main Proposition 7 apply

C29.convention: Admission statistics are stage-specific statistics on D_admit; pooled selection and test effects are reported separately (main Table 1)
